text:
laura: Chasing INC-560 remediations  multiple items are overdue and this incident shows a recurring pattern (cache + autoscale). Need one-line status + next action from owners by EOD. Owners: @jamal (JM-11), @rachel (RC-08), @zane (ZV-04).

laura: Action items pulled from postmortem: 
```
- JM-11: router retry budget + guardrails (owner: jamal)  target 2026-03-15
- RC-08: autoscale cooldown + alert tuning (owner: rachel)  target 2026-03-16
- ZV-04: KV cache eviction sampling + alert traces (owner: zane)  target 2026-03-17
```

oncall-bot: AUTO: INC-560 remediation overdue reminder sent to jamal, rachel, zane.

jamal: JM-11  working on the backoff patch; opened a draft PR to get early feedback: https://git.internal/r/redwood/router/pull/318. Hitting a perf regression on long-tail retries, investigating.

rachel: RC-08  tuned cooldowns in staging and saw fewer flaps. Need ops review before pushing to prod. Filed OPS-209 for review.

zane: ZV-04  sampling implemented in staging but traces are missing user context in prod; pending a small agent change from eng-runtime. Filed INF-701 and pinged @eng-runtime.

laura: Thanks. If any external dependency will add >48h delay call it out here so we can reassign temporarily. This thread is also tracking a recurrence of cache/autoscale issues across incidents.

lei: Heads-up: if JM-11 or ZV-04 are still blocked after 48h I'll reassign a temporary owner to keep progress. Please add an explicit next action that someone can pick up.

jamal: Next action: isolate the perf regression and run a microbenchmark. If that fails, fallback plan is to apply a conservative config change and iterate. ETA 24-36h.

rachel: Ops review requested; if OPS-209 reviewer doesn't land approval by EOD I'll split the doc and push a minimal change to unblock.

zane: INF-701 reply from eng-runtime: agent change scheduled for tomorrow AM (1780001800). I'll coordinate a quick pairing and aim to push prod by tomorrow evening.

oncall-bot: REMINDER: escalation window for INC-560 begins in 48h. Owners: jamal, rachel, zane.

laura: Quick process note: when a remediation is handed off, add `blocked-reassign` to the postmortem tracker and include a new owner in the tracker so we don't lose ownership.

jamal: PR opened (non-draft): https://git.internal/r/redwood/router/pull/318 (1779999800). Added benchmark notes in PR description.

rachel: Pushed minimal cooldown change to prod to reduce incidents: https://git.internal/r/redwood/platform/commit/2b9f8c1 (1780002400). I also left a TODO in the tracker to follow up with a longer-term autoscale test.

zane: eng-runtime change merged and deployed (1780003000)  commit: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/commit/6c7d5e4. I deployed the sampling to prod and verified traces include user context.

laura: Verified links for JM-11, RC-08, ZV-04. I updated the postmortem tracker: JM-11 -> in-progress (benchmarked), RC-08 -> remediated-minor, ZV-04 -> remediated. I will wait 48h before marking verified to ensure no regressions.

lei: Noted. Because this pattern has repeated, I'm scheduling a 30-min reliability deep-dive next week to discuss systemic fixes (cache sizing, autoscale playbooks). I'll add scribes and owners.

jamal: After running the microbenchmarks the regression was due to a lock contention edge case; patch landed (1780003400)  commit: https://git.internal/r/redwood/router/commit/9f1a2b3. Performance looks stable in canary.

laura: Great. Once the canary passes for 48h we'll mark these as verified. Thanks for the quick turnaround. If anything regresses reopen INC-560 or file INF-... and @mention #incidents. :white_check_mark:
